self_record.route: committed local YAML, coverage.note and depth

independent_reading.route: committed local YAML, readings.reason and depth

taxonomy.route: committed local YAML, tracks and topic IDs

access: Read committed repository files in place. No download, network request or accelerator.

state_rule.lowered by a reading: The self note explicitly records a lowering from an earlier claimed depth after an independent reading, and the current self depth is no deeper than that reading after the ordinal mapping.
state_rule.held by a reading: The self note explicitly says the independent reading or its missing runnable task kept a shallower self value, and no later raise supersedes that hold.
state_rule.settled by measurement: The self note names a laboratory, inspector, command, notebook, or measured result and says what that local result established. A reason explicitly closing all requested components also qualifies when the self reviewed_scope describes a measured local laboratory task and the note states its bounded decision. This state concerns only that local result.
state_rule.open: Both the self note and the independent reason carry substantive text without a local measured conclusion or a recorded hold/lowering. Their paired wording leaves the topic-level question unsettled. A missing test is recorded separately; generic calls for more work do not provide one.
state_rule.unexamined: Neither the self note nor the independent reason carries substantive text beyond depth and evidence identifiers.
held_phrases: recorded at executable rather than assessed
no runnable task, which compares as worked

falsifier_rule.decision: For open and held topics, a named falsifier exists only when a note or reason contains a listed discriminating-observation phrase or a sentence with both a missing-measurement cue and one of the six named family vocabularies. A generic sentence such as 'more work is needed' does not qualify. Open without either is counted as unfalsifiable and never reported as well-posed.

excluded_by_design: No claim that a question is scientifically settled
No ranking of tracks by how many questions they leave open
No use of a note's wording as evidence that the underlying measurement was made
No re-scoring of either comparison record or inference of reader learning
